name: Hive 1.4.0
notes: Diagnostics, audit, and timestamps. Internal errors are now logged to a rolling file (and surfaced in Settings -> Diagnostics), so background failures in sync, agents, scheduling, and workflows — plus panics — are visible after the fact instead of vanishing to a stderr no one sees; set HIVE_LOG=debug for more. The People pane gains a Membership history audit projected from the signed config log (who joined or was removed, by whom, and when), and join times are now stamped correctly. Messages show a proper wall-clock timestamp with day separators in the transcript (full date + relative age on hover).
